CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SHIVASHANKAR AMARANNAVAR  ORAL ORDER

This petition is filed by accused Nos.1 to 8 under Section 482 of BNSS praying to grant anticipatory bail in Crime No.114/2025 of Doddaballapura Town Police Station registered for offences punishable under Section 420, 468, 471 of IPC.

2. Heard learned counsel for petitioner and learned Additional SPP for the respondent -State.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner would contend that the complaint has been made by the Sub Registrar on the representation given by one Sri A. Ganesh Aditya.
The said that Sri A. Ganesh Aditya is real estate agent.

Petitioners have not executed any sale agreement in favour of the said A.
Ganesh Aditya.
Petitioners are owners of the property and as owners they have sold the property to Ravi Prakash.
There is no transaction between petitioner and A. Ganesh Aditya.
Petitioners are ready to NC: 2026:KHC:140 HC-KAR co-operate with the police in investigation and abide by any conditions to be imposed by this Court.
Offences alleged against petitioners are not punishable either with death or imprisonment for life.
With these, he prays to allow the petition.
4. Per contra, learned Additional SPP for the respondent -State would contend that the petitioners have executed registered sale agreement in favour of A. Ganesh Aditya.
The said A. Ganesh Aditya has filed suit against the petitioners wherein an injunction has been granted restraining petitioners from alienating the property.
In spite of the said order of injunction the petitioners have got registered the sale deed in different Sub Registrar's Office.
The said Sub Registrar who has registered the sale deed has been suspended.
Petitioners have produced forged documents in order to get sale deed registered.
The matter is under investigation and petitioners are required for custodial interrogation.
With this, he prayed to reject the petition.

sentences.text: Having heard learned counsels, this Court has perused the FIR, complaint and other materials placed on record.

6. Case has been registered against petitioner No.1 and others in Crime No.114/2025 in Doddapalapura Town Police Station for aforesaid offences on the complaint of Sub Registrar,
Doddapalapura.
In the said complaint, the allegation against petitioners is that they have executed registered sale agreement in favour of Sri. A. Ganesh Aditya dated 28.01.2021 and it is registered sale agreement.
The said A. Ganesh Aditya has filed suit wherein injunction has been granted against petitioners restraining them from alienating the property.
In spite of the said injunction petitioners have sold the property to one Satish H. S. and got registered the document and cheated the A. Ganesh Aditya.
The entire case of the prosecution is based on the documents.
Petitioners are ready to co-operate with the police in the investigation.
Offences alleged against petitioners are not NC: 2026:KHC:140 HC-KAR punishable either with death or imprisonment.
There are no criminal antecedents of the petitioner.
Considering the above aspects, petitioners have made out case for grant of anticipatory bail with conditions.

7. In the result, the following ORDER i) The petition is allowed.
ii) The petitioners are ordered to be released on bail in the event of their arrest in Crime No.114/2025 of Doddaballapura Town Police Station registered for offences punishable under Section 420, 468, 471 of IPC subject to following conditions:
a) Petitioners - accused Nos.1 to 8 shall voluntarily appear before the Investigating Officer within 15 days from this day and execute bail bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
each with one surety for the likesum to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer.
NC: 2026:KHC:140 HC-KAR b)
Petitioners - accused Nos.1 to 8 shall co- operate with the Investigating Officer in investigation and appear before the Investigating Officer whenever called for.
c) Petitioners - accused Nos.1 to 8 shall not tamper the prosecution witnesses either directly or indirectly.

d) Petitioners - accused Nos.1 to 8 shall not directly or indirectly make an inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such a facts to the court or police officer or tamper with the evidence.

Sd/-
(SHIVASHANKAR AMARANNAVAR) JUDGE DSP List No.: 1 Sl No.: 53 Ct.sm Sri. Gopalappa vs The State Of Karnataka on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32332299/
